name: Astro Sheet Metal Co., Inc.
old_description: Astro is a family-owned custom metal fabrication company founded in 1967 in Irving, Texas.
about:
Astro Sheet Metal Co., Inc. is a family-owned custom metal fabrication company founded in 1967 in Irving, Texas. Now headquartered in Grand Prairie, Texas, the company has operated for over five decades under family ownership.

The shop provides architectural and industrial metal solutions, handling projects from design assistance and submittal drawings through mockup fabrication, brake forming of metal up to 14 feet long, welding, cutting, and final installation. It serves general contractors and subcontractors with architectural metal scopes for bar areas, ceilings, elevator entries, and reception areas, while also supplying custom fittings, hoppers, platforms, and transitions for food-service and plant-maintenance clients. Rush delivery is offered throughout the Dallas/Fort Worth and Austin regions.

Astro's project portfolio spans healthcare (OU Medical Center, Texas Health Resources), hospitality (Bowie House Hotel, Hall Park Hotel), entertainment (Meow Wolf), education (College Station City Hall), government, commercial real estate (AMLI Fountain Place, Granite Park), and retail (Crocs Storefront). Its customers include designers, builders, general contractors, and subcontractors across Texas and Oklahoma.

The company emphasizes rapid turnaround times and a single-source approach from consulting to installation, a model shaped by its founding focus on precision and speed. Family ownership and over 50 years of experience are cited as foundations for its reliability in delivering complex architectural metalwork on schedule.
